# DA-014-REF: the one DigiAsset carrier rule, written down. Hand-derived from the reference, not
# generated from either implementation:
#   DigiAsset Core DigiAsset::decodeAssetTxHeader -- the LAST output whose type is "nulldata" is the
#   only one read; if it is not tagged "DA" the transaction is no DigiAsset transaction.
#   DigiByte Core Solver -- "nulldata" = OP_RETURN followed only by complete pushes (IsPushOnly).
# The wallet's answer, failing closed:
#   NONE        no output is tagged "DA"
#   CARRIER:<i> output <i>, the last nulldata output, is the carrier (no tagged output is unclassifiable)
#   UNDECIDED   tagged somewhere, but no carrier may be credited from: every output is held
# Checked by native (BRTxAssetCarrier, host KAT asset_carrier_reference_kat) and by Kotlin
# (DigiAssetCarrierRule, DigiAssetCarrierVectorsTest). Change the rule in both, then here.
#
# v <name> <expected> <output script hex>...
